title: Delhi HC Stays JNU's Termination of Professor Akoijam for Want of Prior Notice
case_name: Angomcha Bimol Akoijam v. Jawaharlal Nehru University
card_summary: JNU terminated Professor Angomcha Bimol Akoijam with immediate effect on 9 October 2026, after an internal inquiry into a sexual harassment complaint by eleven students. Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani stayed it because no notice was given before the decision, and issued notice to JNU. The stay only pauses the termination; the inquiry findings are still to be tested, with the matter listed for January 2027.
card_tip: A termination order passed without prior notice to the employee is vulnerable to an interim stay on that ground alone, even where the underlying allegations are serious and a separate criminal complaint is pending.
verification_notes: Order date (2 Nov 2026), bench (Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani), basis for the stay (no prior notice), termination date (9 Oct 2026) and the next listing (January 2027) confirmed across Bar and Bench, LiveLaw and ThePrint. This is an interim order, not a final ruling on the termination; summary and tip worded accordingly. W.P.(C) number not confirmed; citation left blank.
